name: TrueSpend — LLM Consumption Tracking
description: Runs daily at 06:30. Pulls yesterday's token usage from Anthropic and OpenAI APIs for all registered keys, inserts llm_consumption rows, charges the ai_consumption budget bucket via record_spend RPC, and raises an anomaly ticket if any key's spend is >3× its 7-day rolling average.

parameters.jsCode:
const anomalies = $('Build Consumption Rows').item.json.anomalies;
const date = $('Build Consumption Rows').item.json.yesterdayStr;

return anomalies.map(a => ({ json: {
  reference:    'TS-' + new Date().getFullYear() + '-' + Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000),
  source:       'automatic',
  status:       'pending_confirm',
  title:        'LLM spend anomaly — ' + a.team_name + ' (' + a.provider + ') — ' + a.ratio + '× daily avg',
  description:  'Daily LLM spend spike detected: ' + date + ' ' + a.team_name + ' (' + a.provider + ') key consumed €' + a.cost_eur + ' vs 7-day avg €' + a.daily_avg_eur + ' (' + a.ratio + '×). Threshold: 3×. Investigate before monthly budget charge.',
  category:     'ai_consumption',
  amount:       a.cost_eur,
  amount_eur:   a.cost_eur,
  currency:     'EUR',
  branch_id:    a.branch_id,
  cost_center_id: a.cost_center_id,
  review_type:  null,
  review_notes: 'Key: ' + a.key_ref + '. Provider: ' + a.provider + '. Ratio: ' + a.ratio + '×. Date: ' + date + '.',
  created_at:   new Date().toISOString(),
  updated_at:   new Date().toISOString()
} }));
